values.en:
Terminology for functions. The Pointer opens the complete registration module. Native declaration names and full argument indices are preserved; named `english` styles extend, rather than replace, existing upstream defaults.

| Lean constant | Style | Display template |
|---|---|---|
| `Function.Injective` | `english` | `#2 is injective` |
| `Function.Surjective` | `default` | `#2 is surjective` |
| `Function.Bijective` | `default` | `#2 is bijective` |
| `Function.LeftInverse` | `default` | `#2 is a left inverse of #3` |
| `Function.RightInverse` | `default` | `#2 is a right inverse of #3` |
| `Function.HasLeftInverse` | `default` | `#2 has a left inverse` |
| `Function.HasRightInverse` | `default` | `#2 has a right inverse` |
| `Function.Involutive` | `default` | `#1 is an involution` |
| `Equiv` | `default` | `#0 \simeq #1` |
| `Function.comp` | `default` | `\left(#3 : #1 \to #2\right) \circ \left(#4 : #0 \to #1\right)` |
| `Function.comp` | `applied` | `\left(\left(#3 : #1 \to #2\right) \circ \left(#4 : #0 \to #1\right)\right)(#5)` |
| `id` | `default` | `\mathrm{id}_{#0}` |
| `id` | `applied` | `\mathrm{id}_{#0}(#1)` |
| `Function.const` | `default` | `\operatorname{const}_{#1 \to #0}(#2)` |
| `Function.const` | `applied` | `\operatorname{const}_{#1 \to #0}(#2)(#3)` |

Composition, identity and constant functions have separate function-valued and applied styles. Left and right inverses remain distinct.
values.zh-CN:
函数的 Lean 术语宏。Pointer 指向完整的注册模块。沿用原生声明名称及完整参数索引；命名为 `english` 的 Style 是对已有默认 Style 的补充，而非替换。

| Lean constant | Style | Display template |
|---|---|---|
| `Function.Injective` | `english` | `#2 is injective` |
| `Function.Surjective` | `default` | `#2 is surjective` |
| `Function.Bijective` | `default` | `#2 is bijective` |
| `Function.LeftInverse` | `default` | `#2 is a left inverse of #3` |
| `Function.RightInverse` | `default` | `#2 is a right inverse of #3` |
| `Function.HasLeftInverse` | `default` | `#2 has a left inverse` |
| `Function.HasRightInverse` | `default` | `#2 has a right inverse` |
| `Function.Involutive` | `default` | `#1 is an involution` |
| `Equiv` | `default` | `#0 \simeq #1` |
| `Function.comp` | `default` | `\left(#3 : #1 \to #2\right) \circ \left(#4 : #0 \to #1\right)` |
| `Function.comp` | `applied` | `\left(\left(#3 : #1 \to #2\right) \circ \left(#4 : #0 \to #1\right)\right)(#5)` |
| `id` | `default` | `\mathrm{id}_{#0}` |
| `id` | `applied` | `\mathrm{id}_{#0}(#1)` |
| `Function.const` | `default` | `\operatorname{const}_{#1 \to #0}(#2)` |
| `Function.const` | `applied` | `\operatorname{const}_{#1 \to #0}(#2)(#3)` |

复合、恒等与常值函数分别提供函数本身和作用于参数后的 Style；左逆和右逆不混同。
